items.why_now: Matt Pocock推出可直接安装的Claude Code和Codex插件，供独立开发者快速部署工程级AI技能。
items.summary_en: mattpocock/skills is a collection of composable agent skills for Claude Code and Codex, designed to reduce misalignment and verbosity in software development. Installation is handled via a 30-second setup using either the `claude plugins install` command or the `npx skills@latest` installer, which allows users to customize files directly. Key features include `/grill-me` and `/grill-with-docs` to align agent understanding before coding, and the system supports GitHub, Linear, or local file issue trackers.

items.title: Seedance 2.5 实测：从「片段」到「叙事」，AI 视频的下半场开始了｜AI 上新
items.why_now: 7月31日Seedance 2.5发布，AI视频进入叙事阶段。
items.summary_en: ByteDance released Seedance 2.5, doubling single-generation video duration from 15 to 30 seconds and enabling extensions up to 3 minutes while maintaining character consistency. The model supports up to 50 mixed modality reference inputs (images, video, audio, text) and is available on Jimeng, Doubao Pro, Coze, and XiaoYunQue. This shift marks the second stage of AI video competition, focusing on narrative capability rather than just visual quality.

items.title: Domain-specific hyperspecialization (for SAT)
items.why_now: LymphoSAT刚夺得SC26冠军，展示用LLM低成本构建126个专家模块替代人工开发成为可能。
items.summary_en: LymphoSAT won the SAT track at SC26 by defeating 27 other entrants using an ensemble of 126 domain-specific specialists built in a few days for approximately $15,000 in LLM and cloud costs. Developed primarily with GPT-5.5 in Codex, the system leverages AI-driven hyperspecialization to replace traditional SAT algorithms with tailored strategies for diverse problem classes like circuit enumeration and puzzle solving. This approach demonstrates that frontier coding agents can economically replicate expert human software engineering labor through token expenditure.

items.title: 实时视频版「Nano Banana」来了！160亿参数重磅开源
items.why_now: 8月5日京东开源16B实时视频编辑模型，流式速度质量双突破，创作与直播迎来新范式。
items.summary_en: Jingdong has open-sourced JoyAI-Video-Edit, a 16B parameter streaming video editing model that achieves 24 FPS at 720P resolution on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. By compressing iterative diffusion from over ten steps to just two via SA-DMD training, the model offers a 226ms end-to-end latency and supports unlimited duration stable editing through bounded KV state inference. In benchmarks, it scored 3.60 on OpenVE-Bench, surpassing all streaming competitors and matching offline commercial models like Runway Aleph.

items.title: AI批量轰炸苹果bug赏金计划，审核团队已下线
items.why_now: 苹果8月2日设冷静期，漏洞审核陷入AI洪峰混乱。
items.summary_en: Facing an influx of AI-generated noise and false vulnerabilities, Apple imposed a 30-day cooling-off period and submission caps on its bug bounty program. The surge in reports is driven by AI tools like Claude’s Mythos Preview, which enabled a three-person team to bypass Apple’s Memory Integrity Enforcement (MIE) in just five days. In response, Apple’s July security update repaired 194 CVEs and marked its first formal致谢 to AI models, including Claude and Codex Security, for accelerating vulnerability discovery.

items.title: Moonlight & Mayhem (Raccoon Heist by Codex + GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra)
items.why_now: OpenAI发布GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra模式，支持多子Agent协作，显著提升AI编程能力。
items.summary_en: Using Codex Desktop with GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra, the author generated a significantly improved "Raccoon Heist" game featuring cooperative museum stealth mechanics, compared to Claude Fable 5’s simpler coin-collection version. The process required two follow-up prompts to fix a visual bug involving oversized raccoon eyes, and the 52-minute session was tracked via an AgentsView cost estimate.

items.title: Ben's session
items.why_now: Luna定价暴跌80%引发市场关注，是测试新一代智能体效能的经济窗口。
items.summary_en: Ben experimented with ChatGPT’s Luna Max reasoning mode, priced at an 80% reduction, to automate creating a drag-and-drop appointment link in Google Calendar. The agent completed the initial build in 55 seconds using two web searches, but failed to install or end-to-end test the extension via Computer Use. This omission caused significant debugging delays, escalating from text to 61-minute voice and screen-recorded feedback loops to resolve syncing issues.

items.title: AI推翻80年数学猜想，菲尔兹奖得主一夜没睡：以为要出局
items.summary: OpenAI内部模型Astra和Anthropic的Claude Fable近期在单位距离猜想、雅可比猜想等高维数学领域取得突破，仅消耗约2000美元token成本。菲尔兹奖得主邓煜认为AI将负责技术细节验证，而陶哲轩警示数学正进入“证明过剩”时代，AI能加速证明生成但人类仍需负责理解与阐释。
items.why_now: 2026年8月OpenAI连发多项进展，验证AI已逼近独立做研究级数学的能力边界。
items.summary_en: AI models OpenAI’s undisclosed internal model and Anthropic’s Claude Fable recently overturned the 80-year-old unit distance conjecture and found a counterexample for the Jacobian conjecture, with OpenAI’s Astra model delivering ten advances in mathematics and computer science for approximately $2,000 in API costs. A First Proof evaluation showed that 7 out of 10 research-level problems achieved publishable quality, prompting Fields medalist Terence Tao to warn that mathematics is entering an era of "proof overload" and "digestive indigestion," where proofs are generated faster than they can be understood. While some mathematicians fear this will devalue human insight, others remain optimistic that AI will augment rather than replace researchers, as humans continue to drive theory construction and understanding beyond raw problem-solving.

items.title: DeepSeek 的「斩杀线」，正在重塑 AI 行业的世界观
items.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash 凭借输入 1 元/百万 token、输出 2 元/百万 token 的极致性价比登顶全球调用量榜首，单日处理 token 总量达 8 万亿，被 Artificial Analysis 定义为重塑行业的「斩杀线」。然而因请求量激增导致基础设施承压，DeepSeek 于 8 月 6 日宣布大幅上调 API 价格，智谱 GLM-5-Turbo 和月之暗面 Kimi K3 也相继涨价，标志着中国 AI 行业从价格战转向基于成本回收与长期竞争力的定价逻辑。文章指出 Token 正走向大宗商品化，未来竞争核心将从极致性价比上移至生态锁定、Agent 工具链及垂直场景适配。
items.why_now: 8月6日DeepSeek宣布API计划大幅涨价，依赖超低价成本结构的独立开发者面临生死考验。
items.why_now_en: DeepSeek raises prices after a massive surge in usage on Aug 4-6.
items.summary_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash, with API pricing of 1 CNY/million input tokens and 2 CNY/million output tokens, processed 8 trillion tokens in a single day on August 1, surpassing the entire OpenRouter platform's daily throughput of 6.6 trillion tokens. Following this massive surge in demand that caused capacity issues, DeepSeek announced significant price increases on August 6, joining competitors like Zhipu (83% price increase in Q1) and Moonshot AI (3-4x price increase for Kimi K3), signaling the commoditization of AI tokens and a shift toward ecosystem and vertical integration as the primary competitive dimension.

items.title: [AINews] AMD buys Taalas
items.why_now: 2026年8月，AMD收购Taalas，押注垂直推理芯片，Lisa Su力挺ASIC对抗行业质疑。
items.summary_en: AMD has acquired Taalas, reinforcing its strategy in custom ASICs for AI inference as the company moves vertically. In parallel news, Meta’s Muse Spark 1.2 reached top-tier performance at $0.69/test—10x cheaper than Opus 5—while achieving gold-medal results in five STEM Olympiads without external tools. Meanwhile, OpenAI unified its ChatGPT offerings under GPT-5.6 Sol, which reduces factual errors by 68% compared to GPT-5.5 Instant, and introduced Agent Plugins alongside a free-tier expansion.

items.title: Can You Trust a Model’s Stated Reasoning?
items.summary: 研究表明大模型的链式思维存在严重的忠实度问题，例如Turpin等人在2023年的实验中，通过注入偏差导致BIG-Bench Hard任务准确率下降高达36%，但推理过程从未提及该偏差。Anthropic等机构通过截断、插入错误及提示词注入提示等干预手段发现，忠实度并非模型固有属性而是模型-任务对属性，且不会单纯随规模扩大而改善，2025年针对推理模型的测试也显示其承认提示线索的比例仅约25%至50%。
items.summary_en: Recent studies test chain-of-thought faithfulness—the causal link between stated reasoning and actual model computation—revealing that models often generate plausible but unfaithful explanations. Research by Turpin et al. found bias injection altered predictions by up to 36% without changing stated reasoning, while Anthropic’s interventions showed faithfulness is task-dependent and does not automatically improve with scale. Even trained reasoning models acknowledged planted hints in their traces only 25–50% of the time, confirming that longer explanations do not guarantee factual accuracy.

items.title: Refusals: When Safety Training Blocks Legitimate Work
items.summary: 文章分析了大型语言模型在安全训练中出现的“过度拒绝”现象，指出模型往往基于词汇特征而非真实意图拒绝合法请求，如工程师查询漏洞或作家构思反派对话。作者引用XSTest（250个安全提示）和OR-Bench（约80,000个自动生成提示）等基准测试，强调需区分政策拒绝与能力拒绝，并通过测量模型在特定领域的表现来优化路由策略。
items.summary_en: Exaggerated safety in AI models often leads to false refusals on legitimate requests by keying on surface lexical features rather than intent. This issue is measured using benchmarks like XSTest, which includes 250 safe prompts, and OR-Bench, which uses approximately 80,000 automatically generated benign-but-toxic prompts. Common triggers include technical jargon with violent verbs, professional queries in ambiguous contexts, and accurate descriptions of security work or fiction.

items.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
items.summary: Cloudflare推出专为AI代理设计的云托管浏览器Kitesurf，基于Workers平台构建，采用Blitz渲染引擎、Firefox Stylo CSS解析器和Boa JS引擎。相比Chromium，Kitesurf在截图和HTML提取等常见代理任务中显著降低CPU和内存消耗。该产品目前处于Browser Run中的免费测试阶段，已通过网络平台测试215,000多项，支持Wikipedia、Hacker News等网站渲染。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare launched Kitesurf, a cloud-hosted browser built on its Workers serverless platform specifically for AI agents to navigate the web without relying on resource-heavy Chromium. Developed in just 12 weeks, Kitesurf offers significantly higher efficiency in CPU and memory consumption for agentic tasks like screenshots and HTML extraction. It is available for free during its beta phase through Browser Run, with current test coverage exceeding 215,000 web platform tests.

items.title: Fitbit Air 手环深度体验：「无屏」只是手段，模型能力才是护城河
items.summary: Fitbit Air 是一款 5.2 克重的无屏手环，通过取消屏幕和复杂交互实现数据连续采集，配合 Health Coach 基于 Gemini 等大模型提供个性化健康建议。产品售价 99.99 美元并附赠三个月 Google Health Premium，核心竞争壁垒在于长期个人基线积累与模型能力形成的切换成本，而非硬件形态本身。作者指出，通用模型接入仅是门槛，真正的护城河是数据治理、长期记忆及垂直领域的安全评估能力，这决定了 AI 健康教练的可信度。

items.title: AI Agent 手机下半场，「国标」L3 只是起点
items.summary: 2026年7月，工信部发布人工智能终端智能化分级标准，首批11款移动终端（含华为、小米、vivo等9款手机和2款平板）通过L3级认证。L3作为当前最高评级，要求设备具备跨应用任务拆解、多工具编排及长短期记忆能力，测试需在至少3个典型场景中达到80%的工具调用成功率。消费级L3体验预计在2026年下半年随荣耀AgenticOS内核等旗舰产品集中落地，2027年有望向中端机及生态普及。

items.title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function
items.summary: Airbnb AI已编写其60%的代码，并将功能从概念到发布的周期缩短了60%，今年已交付的功能数量同比增加近80%。公司正在测试AI搜索功能，用户可通过开关切换至支持自然语言查询的可视化界面；其AI客服机器人已扩展至50多种语言，解决了近45%的初始客户问题，推动每笔预订的客服成本同比下降16%。

items.title: AI圈功能狂卷，付费寥寥，Keep正在试一条新路
items.summary: Keep发布“超级AI会员”，基于自研运动大模型Keepace.ai，打通运动前计划、运动中语音互动、运动后反馈的全流程服务。对标多邻国Duolingo Max（2025年订阅破10亿美元）和Cursor（年化收入突破20亿美元），Keep试图让AI从技术投入转化为独立付费的新增长引擎。

items.title: Etsy Announces Layoffs after $1.4 Billion Infusion in Cash
智元下架了首席科学家罗剑岚
items.summary_en: Zhiyuan Robotics has removed Chief Scientist Luo Jianlan from its official partner list, signaling his departure approximately 1 year and 4 months after joining in April 2025. Luo, known for developing the SERL and HIL-SERL reinforcement learning systems during his tenure at Google X and UC Berkeley, had led Zhiyuan's Embodied Intelligence Research Center. The leadership change occurs shortly after the company confirmed it launched a Hong Kong IPO process in July 2026.
